summary: Backend + frontend verification of new Encounter → Consultation → Billing worklist. 7/7 pytest cases pass on public URL. Frontend worklist renders filter chips with correct counts (All 8, To Start 1, Open 3, In Consult 3, Completed 1), stage badges, payment badges, Rx chip, and per-row action buttons. Seeded 'Worklist ToStart' booking bk_wltest_* correctly surfaces as a to_start row.
critical_code_review_comments: encounters.py:328 — datetime(*(int(x) for x in day.split('-'))) will crash if the date query param is invalid (not YYYY-MM-DD). Non-blocking (validated upstream), but consider a try/except.
encounter_worklist scope filter only supports single stages; consider comma-separated multi-scope in future to reduce round trips.
recompute_encounter_payment uses paid_sum>=fee comparison — a 0-fee encounter with any positive receipt correctly flips to 'paid'. Confirmed by tests.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_WL Patient / TEST_WL Waive / TEST_WL Complete encounters + a 500 INR receipt against them. These are safe to leave in a preview DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/test_encounter_worklist_flow.py — uses owner token test_session_1781800271528 + X-Clinic-Id clinic_a97b903f2fb2. Frontend testIDs on the worklist: wl-search, wl-filter-{all|to_start|open|in_consultation|completed}, wl-row-<id>, wl-start-enc-<bkid>, wl-start-consult-<encid>, wl-resume-<encid>, wl-new, wl-followups, wl-back.
